title: Abstaining when inputs are missing: worst-case bounds, imputation spread and pattern submodels (NHANES prescreening): code, knowledge schema and results
description: Code, JSON-LD knowledge schema, analysis protocol, tests and results for a comparison of abstention rules for missing inputs (worst-case bounds over admissible values, imputation spread, pattern submodels, point-score selective prediction, complete cases) with three base models (a fuzzy additive model built from the knowledge schema, sign-constrained and spline logistic regression), applied to prescreening elevated depressive symptoms (PHQ-9 >= 10) from non-symptom NHANES survey data. Includes algorithms for exact worst-case bounds of fuzzy additive rule bases, a bound-guided input acquisition rule, and the statistics file that populates the manuscript.
